text:
jessica: Hey team — customer hit repeated 403s on POST /v1/generate after our org key rotation. They attached a curl but we can't repro internally. Can someone pick this up?

emily: attaching the original request id from the user's logs: req-20260317-8b7c. User says it started right after rotation at 2026-03-17T14:02:11Z.

jessica: thanks — @devon can you check if that req id shows up on the gateway? if not, we need the customer's raw curl and a debug bundle.

devon: looking. quick note: many 403s after rotation are due to org header mismatch (org id in token != X-Redwood-Org). will search for req-20260317-8b7c now.

opsbot: gateway log search initiated for "req-20260317-8b7c" across us-east-1 / 24h window. returning partial matches (streaming).

devon: found two spans where token validation failed, similar trace id trace-6a4f. Gateway returned 403 with code AUTH_SCOPE_MISMATCH. Logged headers: Authorization: Bearer <redacted>, x-redwood-org-id: org-493-old. Token contained org claim: org-493-new.

anil: that matches the "rotated org id" symptom. Customer likely kept an old org header while service keys rotated. Can we ask for a repro curl from their environment (not our quick UI test) with -v and the exact Authorization + x-redwood-org-id they send?

jessica: yes. ask them to curl with full verbose and include request-id header. Ask them to run `curl --version` and include it, plus the timestamp in UTC. Also request any proxy/nginx in front of their app — those sometimes rewrite/remove headers.

rachel: I'll draft a repro request to send.

rachel: @emily can you send this to the customer? Paste exact instructions below.

rachel: Hi — to help us reproduce the 403 please run from the client host that experiences the failure and paste the full output. Replace the token with the one you used (keep it literal so we can see header formatting):

```
curl -v -X POST "https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/generate" \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <PASTE_TOKEN_HERE>" \\
  -H "X-Redwood-Org-Id: <PASTE_ORG_HEADER_HERE>" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -H "X-Request-Id: req-20260317-8b7c-client" \\
  -d '{"input":"hello"}'
```

Please also run `curl --version` and paste the exact output. If you have an edge/proxy in front of the client, please capture `tcpdump -s 0 -w /tmp/capture.pcap port 443` (10s) and attach, or if that's not possible, a copy of the proxy/nginx access + error logs around the UTC time 2026-03-17T14:02:00Z to 14:05:00Z.

Additionally, if you can hit our debug-collector endpoint it helps: POST the same curl with header `X-Debug-Allow: true` to https://collector.redwood-inference.example/debug-bundle and paste the returned bundle id.

emily: customer replied with curl -v output and they show header as `X-Redwood-Org-Id: org-493-old` indeed. They said they updated tokens but rolling deploy left some agents with old config. They attached agent logs showing `token_claims.org=org-493-new` and outgoing header set to org-493-old.

devon: that explains 403 AUTH_SCOPE_MISMATCH. Two action items: 1) ask customer to set org header to match token (or remove header so token claim governs) and retry; 2) we should add a helper in Support playbook to detect common mismatch patterns and return a clearer error for next time.

anil: for repro bundle — I pulled the gateway trace:```
[gateway] time=2026-03-17T14:02:11Z req=req-20260317-8b7c auth_status=403 code=AUTH_SCOPE_MISMATCH token_org=org-493-new header_org=org-493-old peer=10.4.20.11
```

anil: attaching that as inline snippet for the record. If we need a full debug bundle I can mark this as P1 and request infra capture from the customer's region.

jessica: good. rachel, send the remediation steps and offer a short window to test while we watch logs. devon, can you add a temporary query on the dashboard to surface recent AUTH_SCOPE_MISMATCH errors by org pair? want to see if it's widespread.

rachel: sent remediation and offered 30m watch window. customer will rotate the header on 14:35Z and test.

devon: added a quick saved query and alerted on >10 occurrences in 10m. will escalate if spike.

emily: customer confirmed success after changing header to org-493-new. they retried same request id (req-20260317-8b7c-client) and got 200.

jessica: great — mark resolved, include notes that root cause was mismatched org header from stale agent config after key rotation. Recommend customer remove manual X-Redwood-Org-Id header or ensure it reads from same secret as token. :white_check_mark:

rachel: closing thread, will file a short KB blurb for support playbook about 'org header vs token mismatch' and attach repro steps.
